scope: Two retained IA volumes, scans as textual authority, 1070 access-format OCR pages plus two unique scan-only text pages represented for review

volumes.deleted_leaf_disposition: Leaves 208/209 are lower-quality spread scans of printed pages 200/201, duplicated by included clear rescans 210/211; leaves 0/581 show nontextual cover edges.
Leaves 306/307 contain unique printed pages 298/299, represented by hash-bound local uncorrected Tesseract OCR from their retained JP2 images; leaves 0/495 show nontextual cover edges.

mapping.volume: Separate TEI text members in a group, with independently identified 1825 and 1826 source volumes.
mapping.pages: All 1070 included scandata leaves receive scan-page divisions with PDF index and scan member; volume II leaves 306/307 receive scan-page divisions with source JP2 member and printed page label. Source order is leaf order.
mapping.front_body_back: Front ends at title/advertisement in volume I and title/imprint in II; back starts at Contents leaf 574 or 488 respectively.
mapping.text: Every IA OCR PARAGRAPH with visible words, plus Tesseract paragraphs from unique volume II leaves 306/307, receives a source-ID wrapper and p or explicit heading. Every source text line has an lb and unaltered line string.
mapping.headings: Only standalone CHAPTER/PART and named front/back labels are encoded as head; all other OCR lines remain readable and need scan review.
mapping.exclusions: Every scandata leaf has a retained JP2. Volume I's two mid-volume Delete images duplicate included rescans; volume II's two mid-volume Delete images are unique and represented at their exact source positions. The remaining non-access leaves are cover edges or calibration cards. Every excluded image is individually hashed.

known_limitations: OCR title pages contain obvious errors. The candidate preserves them visibly and does not claim scan-corrected wording.
All 1072 represented scan pages require human visual/text collation for textual fidelity.
Page-spanning paragraphs and non-explicit headings are not semantically joined.
sample_visual_review: Personally viewed retained JP2 scans: volume I leaves 0,207-211,580-581 and volume II leaves 0,306-309,494-495. Tesseract token sequence similarity is 0.971/0.973 for volume I deleted/rescan pairs and 0.08/0.077 for volume II, corroborating distinct printed pages 298/299. This bounded review does not collate all OCR wording.
